source_review: Input values initially entered from a standard table and independently checked numerically against BSE v1 H exponents and coefficients at the published precision.
scope: Only H s-shell numerical parameters are used; PySCF reference receives the same explicit parameters rather than its built-in basis name.
nested_basis: Original educational even-tempered factor-four s-only exponent sets. Each level retains every previous shell; no exponents are optimized and no small-overlap eigenvectors are dropped.
